series: All 13 targets were reviewed semantically against the installed learner-facing checklist; there is no campaign and there are zero workers.

Identity, audience, prior knowledge, first-use terms, goals, scope, non-goals, atomic requirements, measurable acceptance, dependencies, evidence, security, privacy, accessibility, platforms, supply chain, prompts, risks and delivery authority were re-evaluated.

Twelve target hashes are unchanged from review d2c44397-bb36-4557-9e44-5c62313d1e94. The changed PL/0 target was fully re-reviewed for its macOS-15 exact-head CI boundary and unchanged two-stage fail-closed integration gate.

The 6 October CI statements agree with TinyCalc PR 99 and the current workflow matrices: homogeneity pins macos-15, product build/test remains Linux and Windows, and intake governance retains macos-latest.

TinyPl0 v0.4.1, source commit edab567e1e7cd3ea8eb8e3bea425b54f24d4b506, release run 33757534918 and matching public TinyPl0.Core/TinyPl0.Vm 0.4.1 packages were live rechecked. This confirms only external stage 1; TinyCalc preflight and the internal predecessor remain blocking.

The graph has 13 unique ordered targets, four exact zero-indegree roots and nine unique forward hard gates without cycles. Exactly one target is Eligible; eligibility grants no implementation or remote-delivery authority.
No credentials, unnecessary personal data, hidden binary target, unexplained gap, overlap, terminology drift, unresolved material question or accepted risk was found.

applicability.NIST_SSDF: Applicable to the Level-2 review and future secure-development evidence; no product certification is claimed.
applicability.CWE_Top_25: Applicable to formula, file, dependency, execution and VM input boundaries at requirements level.
applicability.WCAG_2_2_AA: Applicable where criteria fit the TUI, documentation and evidence; native TUI, PTY, VoiceOver and DocFX proof remains feature-gated.
applicability.SBOM: Applicable to distributable TinyCalc and TinyPl0 artefacts; the external TinyPl0 release evidence was rechecked without creating a new product release.
applicability.VEX: Applicable when a known shipped or evaluated vulnerability needs disposition; the bound TinyPl0 release step was rechecked and no new disposition is asserted.
applicability.SLSA: Target model for CI and published artefact provenance; the bound TinyPl0 provenance step was rechecked.
applicability.AI_SBOM: N/A because AI is development tooling and not a released or operated TinyCalc runtime component.
applicability.OWASP_ASVS: N/A because TinyCalc is a local TUI without a web, HTTP, API or authentication service.
applicability.ZeroTrust: N/A for the local non-distributed product topology; reassess if remote-managed services are added.
applicability.STRIDE_CAPEC: Applicable to future PL/0 execution, file import, dependency and sandbox trust boundaries; no new architecture flow is introduced by this review.
applicability.OWASP_SAMM: Recommended maturity context for this long-lived project, not a newly executed assessment.
applicability.OpenSSF_Scorecard: Supporting public OSS and dependency evidence; no fresh Scorecard audit is claimed.
